004 has tiny blank white chest rectangles in seated E/W views that are absent from her standing views. They contain no lettering or logo; this is a minor pose-consistency concern for manager review.

Native extraction retains imperceptible alpha-1 edge noise: four source poses have 47 footprint pixels outside the normalized frame and two derived poses have seven alpha-1 border pixels. No protected alpha clipping occurred. No thresholding, erasing, mirroring or repainting was applied.

Browser gallery validation remains prepared for the manager and was not run by this worker. The 318-identity/2574-asset runtime remains unchanged. Manager acceptance, runtime integration, publication and GitHub backup are not claimed. No browser profile, game origin or campaign storage was accessed or changed.
